policy: Only per-request identities and wall-clock values are normalised. Every other byte, including header order, JSON key order, number spelling and string escaping, is compared exactly. Adding a rule needs a reason naming the source of the varying value; a rule that hides a real difference is a defect.

wireRules.reason: lib/llm/_sse_core.prepare_request mints a random per-request trace id (uuid); it identifies the request, it is not request content
routes/conversation_sync_v3.py emits sync.heartbeat only after heartbeatIntervalMs without a change, so whether and where one appears in a replay is wall-clock timing, not replayed content

durableStateRules.reason: identities minted per deployment (uuid4 / nonce); renamed consistently so equal structure compares equal and a swapped reference still differs
the scripted provider's per-Turn nonce embedded in the user text (tests/chaos/fake_provider.py MARKER)
wall-clock epoch milliseconds of the run
